title: {asset} — {project} Asset Package
intro: This package contains the exported assets and associated files listed below. Each directory entry describes its contents, intended use, filenames and recorded specifications.
relative_paths: All file paths are relative to the package root.
metadata_description: Contains the structured inventory of the included files, their relationships, measurements, production resources and integrity records.
licenses_description: Contains retained license and notice documents associated with the resources recorded in this export. They are separate from Mumblebox terms and any explicitly supplied finished-asset license.
paths_spec: File paths: relative to package root.
manifest_spec: The manifest records all other archive members, including README.md. It excludes its own checksum.
source_not_rewritten: Retained source texts are not rewritten by the catalog.
guided_description: A single-image rough mesh supplied measured Blender views and depth guides. Enhanced views were selected for reconstruction, followed by refinement, cleanup and final texturing.
camera_records: Numerical camera records are listed in the Metadata directory. These describe the renderer targets; camera adherence after enhancement requires visual review.
private_production: Original references, concept edits, prompts and intermediate meshes are retained locally. The separate private production download includes those files.
reference_description: Accepted images created in Foundry and used as references for this asset.
image_terms_note: Image-model terms are separate from the downstream geometry and texturing resources below. The structured record binds each originating image to its accepted revision and checksum.
consult_notices: Consult the retained notices and resource source.
no_provenance: Production provenance was not supplied with these output files.
no_terms: Mumblebox terms: not supplied for this export.
no_asset_license: A finished-asset license has not been assigned by this packaging operation.
